info.title: Cryptal Exchange API
info.description:
General Info

Base URL: https://exchange.cryptal.com/exchange

  • All endpoints return either a JSON object or array.
  • Data is returned in ascending order. Oldest first, newest last.
  • All time and timestamp related fields are in milliseconds.

tags.name: Overview
tags.description:
# Authentication

bearerAuth

All requests require to be fully authenticated through the HTTP header Authorization. The format is Authorization: Bearer {Token}

Security Scheme Type HTTP
HTTP Authorization Scheme bearer
# HTTP Status Codes The API returns the following HTTP status codes: |HTTP Status|Meaning|Description| |---|---|---| |**200**|Success|The operation succeeded| |**400**|Bad Request|The client request is invalid| |**401**|Unauthorized|Authentication failed (e.g. invalid token specified by the Authorization header)| |**403**|Forbidden|Request received, but the operation is not allowed| |**404**|Not Found|Requested resource does not exist| |**500**|Internal Server Error|This error indicates that the server has encountered an unexpected condition # Error Handling If a request fails, the HTTP status code of the response is different and the body contains an error object structuring the detailed cause of the problem. ``` { "errorKey": "validate.unknown_pair", "errorType": "ERROR", "errorMessage": "Unknown pair", "params": null, "transParams": null } ``` The `errorCode` value is the HTTP status code and `errorMessage` is a human-readable description of the specific error.

The first listed currency of a currency pair is called the base currency, and the second currency is called the quote currency. E.g: ETH-BTC, BTC-USD, USDT-USD

baseCurrency.description: In a currency pair quote, the base currency, also known as the primary currency, is the first currency shown. The second currency shown is referred to as the quote currency. Currencies are quoted in relation to other currencies. For example, in the BTC-USD currency pair, BTC is the first currency shown, and always has a value of one. The base currency is the reference element for the exchange rate of the currency pair.

baseScale.description: scale represents the accuracy of a float after a point

quoteCurrency.description: It is used to determine the value of the base currency.

quoteScale.description: scale represents the accuracy of a float after a point

takerFee.description: The maker and taker model is a way to differentiate fees between trade orders that provide liquidity ("maker orders") and take away liquidity ("taker orders"). Maker and taker trade orders are charged different fees.
